title: Finished sessions say all done and close on TJ's word; swaps only carry on the same work

requirements.text: genlock close --self --user-said writes a self close request to the session's channel after the checkpoint check passes
After TJ tells a session it can close, its tab moves to Recently ended once its reply finishes

requirements.text: The launch rule and continuity instructions tell agents to end finished work with an all-done line, close on the user's word, and swap only to carry on the same work
The Assistant's session sweep shows no suggestion to swap a finished session onto the next goal

Swaps must be bulletproof: prove swap, close-and-spawn and new spawn each work, across conditions and paths. Fail-safe: if a spawn or swap fails, the agent finds another way to create the session without waiting for TJ's approval; the main path should just work.
user_said: Yes I want it to be bulletproof Prove it works prove it works under different conditions prove it works in different paths I need the agents to spawn them successfully with a swap with a close and spawn with a new spawn and if an agent can't spawn or swap and it fails it needs to know to find any way to create the session without waiting for me for approval But that's that is a fail safe I wanted to just work

text: unblocked: TJ asked to finish and prove swaps

Swap, real run: an agent in a session of a running app runs genlock swap GOAL; once its turn ends its tab holds a fresh session on that goal (with the handed tasks in its opening) and the old conversation is under Recently ended. Proved for a project's main session and for a second session in a split

text: Close-and-spawn, real run: an agent runs genlock open --handoff; a fresh session opens in the same project carrying its tasks, and the old one moves to Recently ended once its turn ends. An agent running close --self on the user's word also moves to Recently ended
check: manual: driven app, real claude agents, report.json before/after

check: manual: driven app, real claude agents, report.json before/after

text: Fail-safe: the app writes a receipt for every open, spawn and swap request; when none arrives in time (app closed, channel dead) genlock takes the request back so it cannot open twice, opens the session in a terminal window itself without asking, and says so
check: node tests/run.mjs (receipt and fallback tests) plus a real run with no app reading the channel

text: A handoff closes the old session only once the fresh one is confirmed open (receipt or fallback window); a refused or lost open leaves the old session running and says why

Agent rules (Voice launch rule, continuity skill, AGENTS.md) say: if a swap, open or spawn reports it failed, create the session another way at once (fallback window, genlock open) without waiting for the user's approval

Built receipts+fallback: lib/appask.mjs (requestOfApp waits for receipt-ID.json, withdraws on silence), swap/open/handoff/spinoff/Assistant open fall back to a Terminal window; handoff closes only once fresh is confirmed. App writes receipts (AppModel open/spawn/swap). tests/receipts.mjs 15/15. Next: real-agent drive in scratchpad/e2e (drive.json), then fail-safe real run.
